profile.name: 持久化属性
profile.description: 用于实验软件中保存配置、元数据或对象状态的持久化属性组件。它可管理单个属性值，并在普通值、JSON 表示和字典存储格式之间转换，常用于实验记录、参数保存和对象状态持久化；不对应特定物理仪器。
profile.description_en: A persistent property component used in laboratory software to store configuration, metadata, or object state. It manages a single property value and converts between native values, JSON representations, and dictionary-based storage formats. It is commonly used for experiment records, parameter saving, and state persistence, rather than representing a specific physical instrument.

registry.description: Persistent Property是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、加载、复位、读取数据、运动控制。支持Signal, Slot, about to be inserted等操作。
